summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt on October 6, 2026 of a Nasdaq Listings Qualifications letter granting an additional 180-calendar-day period, until April 5, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The deficiency stemmed from 30 consecutive business days below $1.00, first noticed April 8, 2026, with an initial cure deadline of October 5, 2026. Compliance requires a $1.00 closing bid for at least 10 consecutive business days; ADSs (each 10,000 ordinary shares) continue trading under RDHL on the Nasdaq Capital Market, with no immediate effect. Watch reverse-split or ADS-ratio actions and any resulting overhang, plus the April 2027 delisting risk.
